hooks.name: Guard .kiro from gitignore
hooks.description: Fails if .kiro is ever added to .gitignore, which would risk Hackachusetts disqualification.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Select-String -Path .gitignore -Pattern '(^|/)\.kiro' -Quiet) { Write-Error '.kiro must NOT be gitignored (Hackachusetts disqualification risk)'; exit 2 } else { exit 0 }"
